custom_workout_pair_check.name: custom_workout_pair_check
custom_workout_pair_check.value: ("custom_workout_template_steps"."pair_key" is null and "custom_workout_template_steps"."transition_seconds" is null) or ("custom_workout_template_steps"."pair_key" is not null and "custom_workout_template_steps"."transition_seconds" is not null and length("custom_workout_template_steps"."pair_key") between 1 and 80 and "custom_workout_template_steps"."transition_seconds" between 0 and 120)

custom_workout_step_check.name: custom_workout_step_check
custom_workout_step_check.value: "custom_workout_template_steps"."ordinal" between 0 and 39 and "custom_workout_template_steps"."sets" between 1 and 10 and "custom_workout_template_steps"."target" between 1 and 600 and "custom_workout_template_steps"."rest_seconds" between 0 and 600

profiles_settings_check.name: profiles_settings_check
profiles_settings_check.value: "profiles"."theme" in ('dark','rose') and "profiles"."goal" in ('habit','strength','energy') and "profiles"."discipline" in ('strength','calisthenics','mobility','yoga') and "profiles"."location" in ('home','gym','outdoor','workout_park')

profiles_schedule_check.name: profiles_schedule_check
profiles_schedule_check.value: cardinality("profiles"."training_days") between 1 and 7 and "profiles"."training_days" <@ ARRAY[0,1,2,3,4,5,6]::integer[] and "profiles"."reminder_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'

recorded_sets_drop_check.name: recorded_sets_drop_check
recorded_sets_drop_check.value:
"recorded_sets"."drop_result" is null or coalesce((
      "recorded_sets"."reps" is not null and "recorded_sets"."duration_seconds" is null and
      jsonb_typeof("recorded_sets"."drop_result") = 'object' and
      jsonb_typeof("recorded_sets"."drop_result"->'reps') = 'number' and jsonb_typeof("recorded_sets"."drop_result"->'weightKg') = 'number' and
      ("recorded_sets"."drop_result"->>'reps')::numeric between 1 and 100 and
      ("recorded_sets"."drop_result"->>'reps')::numeric = trunc(("recorded_sets"."drop_result"->>'reps')::numeric) and
      ("recorded_sets"."drop_result"->>'weightKg')::numeric > 0 and
      ("recorded_sets"."drop_result"->>'weightKg')::numeric * 1000 < "recorded_sets"."weight_g"
    ), false)

recorded_sets_values_check.name: recorded_sets_values_check
recorded_sets_values_check.value: "recorded_sets"."set_index">=0 and "recorded_sets"."weight_g">=0 and (("recorded_sets"."reps" is not null and "recorded_sets"."reps">0 and "recorded_sets"."duration_seconds" is null) or ("recorded_sets"."reps" is null and "recorded_sets"."duration_seconds" is not null and "recorded_sets"."duration_seconds" between 1 and 86400 and "recorded_sets"."weight_g"=0))

workouts_planner_source_check.name: workouts_planner_source_check
workouts_planner_source_check.value: ("workouts"."source_planner_revision" is null and "workouts"."source_planner_day_key" is null) or ("workouts"."source_planner_revision" is not null and "workouts"."source_planner_day_key" is not null and "workouts"."source_planner_revision" >= 1 and length("workouts"."source_planner_day_key") between 1 and 80)

workouts_load_feedback_check.name: workouts_load_feedback_check
workouts_load_feedback_check.value: "workouts"."load_feedback" is null or ("workouts"."load_feedback" in ('easy','just_right','hard','too_hard') and "workouts"."status" in ('completed','partial'))
